posts.alt: Aerial drone view of a Poway entertainment backyard with Belgard paver patio, built-in grill island, sunken fire lounge and turf lawn against chaparral hills
posts.hook: From up here you can see what actually makes a yard work: the plan.
posts.caption:
From up here you can see the part most people never think about: the plan.

A yard like this starts months before the first paver — grading so water moves away from the house, zones sized for how you actually host, the kitchen placed so the cook stays in the conversation, and sight lines that keep the whole yard connected. Get the plan right and everything after it is execution.

The selections:
• Belgard Dimensions pavers
• Blaze grill in stainless cabinetry
• built-in fire pit lounge
• SYNLawn artificial turf
• agave & ornamental grasses

Want the plan before the pavers? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.alt: Close-up of Warming Trends CrossFire brass burner jets and flames in lava rock inside a stone fire pit at golden hour
posts.hook: Why we spec brass burners you'll never see.
posts.caption:
This is the part of a fire feature nobody photographs — and the reason ours light on the first try, burn full and even in a coastal breeze, and still look like this years in.

Warming Trends CrossFire jets are machined brass, not stamped steel. They pull more air per BTU, so you get taller, brighter flame from less gas. Buried under lava rock, doing quiet work for decades. That's what the premium buys.

The selections:
• Warming Trends CrossFire brass burner
• tumbled lava rock media
• board-formed concrete surround
• Techo-Bloc Aberdeen coping

Want a fire feature built to this standard? DM “DESIGN”.
